evidence: Independent QA correction: Corrected the proposed name because the body does not return a boolean: after validating the nested path and querying attribute id 0x16, it converts the selected value to float and adds 1.0. The caller stores the result as one of several scalar values. This name describes the returned operation without implying a predicate. Source lines: decompiled/main/main_0112.c:33721-33753; decompiled/main/main_0111.c:50130-50134

The body obtains a record pointer using selector 0xd06 and returns whether the byte read at record+0x48+low_byte(input index) differs from 0xff; the caller uses the result as a boolean. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0033.c:52898-52929; caller decompiled/main/main_0082.c:14605-14609. Helper behavior is visible at decompiled/main/main_0170.c:9347-9360.

It returns false when attribute_context_matches_status_0x13_value_4_or_status_0_value_3_or_8 is true; otherwise it returns whether f_7001085860 reports a resource-slot condition. That helper checks up to nine resource slots and per-index flags, but exact meaning of the positive result is unclear. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0120.c:44830-44851; caller decompiled/main/main_0120.c:18567-18571; helper decompiled/main/main_0120.c:44854-45030.

For input values at most 3, initializes an output status context and returns true unless status id 0x13 equals 5 or the low byte of status id 0x14 equals 7; larger values return false. Caller invokes it after a comparison involving 0x3f, but higher-level meaning is unsupported. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:35518-35548; caller decompiled/main/main_0094.c:29550-29554.

The body reads a 32-bit state at input+0x10, may allocate 16 bytes and initialize a GI probe tree shading resource object, or destroy/free a nested resource pointer; no indexed caller is available and the broader lifecycle name is not sufficiently supported. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0136.c:45621-45655; helper lifecycle decompiled/main/main_0136.c:43228-43275.
